item.title: These four Apple products could launch as soon as next month
item.description: The year is coming to a close, and while Apple still has software launches ahead, no new hardware is expected until 2026. But here are four new products that are rumored to be coming early in 2026, possibly as soon as January. more…

item.title: New data shows iPhone Air resale value dropping faster than any recent iPhone
item.description: A new report shows that the iPhone Air registered a steeper drop in resale value during the first 10 weeks of availability compared to the rest of the iPhone 17 line, as well as previous models. Here are the details. more…

item.title: Future iPhone chips might be produced by Intel, per report
item.description: Last week Ming-Chi Kuo reported that Intel was likely to start producing Apple’s M-series chips for Mac and iPad in 2027. Now a separate analyst has corroborated the report, and added that Intel-made iPhone chips will likely come shortly thereafter. more…

item.title: Rewind Mac app shutting down following Meta’s acquisition of Limitless
item.description: Rewind, which recorded and transcribed everything users saw or heard, is shutting down in two weeks, following Meta’s acquisition of its parent company. Here are the details. more…

item.title: Apple TV’s biggest premiere of the year is next week, with key follow-up after
item.description: Apple TV has had a big year already, but next week brings its most high-profile premiere yet: F1 The Movie joins the streaming service. There’s also a key follow-up coming to Apple TV soon with the Formula 1 sport’s arrival. Here are the details. more…

item.title: Car Keys are coming to the Wallet app for 13 new vehicle brands soon
item.description: Apple debuted some great new CarPlay features in iOS 26, but the company has more coming for your vehicle soon. Here are the 13 new vehicle brands that Apple says will soon support car keys in the Apple Wallet app. more…

item.title: New report sheds a bit more light on who at Apple has been departing for OpenAI
item.description: A few days ago, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reported that OpenAI was poaching Apple hardware engineers “left and right”. Now, a new WSJ piece offers a closer look at some of these departures. more…

item.title: India considers new surveillance measure requiring iPhone A-GPS to stay active 24/7
item.description: Fresh off abandoning its controversial mandate to preload a state-run “security” app on all smartphones, the Indian government may already be heading into an even bigger privacy battle. Here are the details. more…

item.title: House panel questions Apple on apps used to track immigration officers
item.description: Following the controversy that led to Apple removing apps like ICEBlock from the App Store a few months ago, US lawmakers want to know what steps the company is taking to prevent similar tools from returning. Here are the details. more…

item.title: Critics Choice Awards: Apple TV’s 26 nominations include Best Drama Series for Pluribus
item.description: Apple has once again picked up multiple nominations for its shows and films, this time at the 31st annual Critics Choice Awards. Here are the details. more…
